(2) The navy-shirted man reaches toward the screen, followed by a digital overlay showing a map of Nangang District. A quick selfie-perspective shot shows both men looking into the camera before a transition occurs. (3) The scene shifts to a massive stage inside a dark performance venue. The two men are kneeling at the front of the stage, microphones in hand, facing a large, dense crowd of hundreds of people. The lighting is bright on stage but dim in the auditorium. (4) A rapid montage follows, showing various angles of the event: hands waving in the crowd, stage lights flashing, and the two men interacting with fans. One man wears a black sleeveless top and sunglasses while clapping for the enthusiastic audience. (5) The video concludes with a group photo of eight people standing in front of a black-and-white checkered backdrop. They are smiling and waving, positioned behind a large sign that reads 'BE YOU 5TH ANNIVERSARY'.
